description: This PHP class 'Config' extends 'BaseConfig' and provides configuration access methods specific to Confluence format in the Daux documentation generator. It includes getters and setters for various configuration options such as page deletion, diff printing, URL prefixes, authentication, space IDs, and header settings.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class for Confluence format in the Daux documentation generator, providing accessors for various configuration parameters.

methods.name: shouldAutoDeleteOrphanedPages
methods.description: Determines whether orphaned pages should be automatically deleted, based on the 'delete' config value.

methods.name: shouldPrintDiff
methods.description: Checks if diff printing is enabled, based on the 'print_diff' config value.

methods.name: getUpdateThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the threshold for updates, defaults to 2.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the URL prefix from configuration.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for Confluence from configuration.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the username for authentication from configuration.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the password for authentication from configuration.

methods.name: getSpaceId
methods.description: Gets the Confluence space ID from configuration.

methods.name: setSpaceId
methods.description: Sets the Confluence space ID in the configuration.

methods.name: hasAncestorId
methods.description: Checks if an ancestor ID is set in the configuration.

methods.name: getAncestorId
methods.description: Retrieves the ancestor ID from configuration.

methods.name: hasRootId
methods.description: Checks if a root ID is set in the configuration.

methods.name: getRootId
methods.description: Retrieves the root ID from configuration.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if header content is set.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the header content from configuration.

methods.name: createRootIfMissing
methods.description: Indicates whether to create a root page if missing, defaulting to false.
